definitional_intent.PILOT_BILLING_READY: The billing-and-entitlement readiness the Commercial V1 stage PILOT_READY requires: a CommercialAccount can become commercially usable WITHOUT Stripe through the explicit, authorized, governed and audited ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE path, administered entirely from the Uellix platform control plane. It is a NECESSARY input to PILOT_READY, never sufficient for it. Normative closed-conjunction definition lives in the companion authority SECTION_3, not here.
definitional_intent.COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE: The later, FULL commercial target: the complete Stripe lifecycle (first binding, checkout, webhook ordering, past_due, suspension, cancellation, reactivation, invoices, dunning and the rest contemplated by HPO-B and the frozen commercial parents). PILOT-BILLING-01 does not delete, weaken or supersede it; it only removes it from the PILOT_READY critical path.
definitional_intent.PRO_BONO: A governed commercial basis for an ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE arrangement. It is not a role, not an authorization bypass, not a Stripe payment and not automatically unlimited. Normative representation lives in the companion authority SECTION_15.

ratifications.title: ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE
ratifications.statement: For the Commercial V1 stage PILOT_READY, Stripe/payment automation is NOT required. A CommercialAccount may become commercially usable through the already-conceived ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE path, but ONLY through an explicit, authorized, governed and audited administrative action in Uellix. From the Uellix administrative control plane an authorized administrator must be able to assign plan/commercial package, entitlement capabilities, credits/limits, effective period/validity, applicable commercial basis, and Pro Bono status/policy where applicable; this must support pro bono service. No routine Pilot activation, plan assignment, entitlement change or credit adjustment may require direct SQL, manual Supabase row editing, developer intervention, or direct manipulation of legacy quota columns. Payment, Activation, Entitlement and Authorization remain separate concerns. Pro Bono is not an authorization bypass and is not automatically unlimited. Full Stripe automation remains part of the later/full COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE target and this decision does not delete, weaken or supersede the full future Stripe lifecycle contemplated by HPO-B / Commercial Core. Pilot Billing should use existing architecture whenever possible rather than create a second billing, quota, credit or entitlement system. No new customer-facing entitlement capability key is authorized merely by this decision; the current production catalogue contains stella.grounded_query.

items.text: The Stripe-specific release gates PV3 and SEC7 are NOT prerequisites of PILOT_READY.
PV3 and SEC7 are NOT deleted, waived, marked PASS or weakened.
PV3 and SEC7 remain mandatory for the full COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE / production-commercial path.

HPO-G.6 and HPO-G.7 are scope-aware: browser and provider gates applicable to the actual Pilot configuration must be satisfied before its Release Candidate; Stripe-specific provider gates are deferred when Stripe is deliberately OFF.

The successor release authority preserves a route in which PV3 and SEC7 become mandatory after PILOT_READY, at the earliest EXISTING post-PILOT_READY stage that preserves the full commercial/production invariant.
Full Stripe automation remains part of Commercial V1 complete.
Payment, Activation, Entitlement and Authorization remain separate.

epr_steady_state_decisions.provenance: OWNER_CONFIRMED_OUTSIDE_THE_REPOSITORY. After the circuit breaker of CV1-PILOT-BILLING-MINIMUM-AUTHORITY-IC-R3-FINAL (FAIL, one blocking finding: residual post-enablement circularity of EPR), the Product Owner adjudicated the EPR steady-state semantic in CV1-PILOT-BILLING-EPR-STEADY-STATE-OWNER-ADJUDICATION-R1 and supplied it as BINDING input to CV1-PILOT-BILLING-EPR-STEADY-STATE-SUCCESSOR-WRITER-R1 (2026-09-26). Normalized, not a verbatim transcript. It fixes the reading of RSC-5 at the payment-provider enablement boundary; it is not a new HPO, changes no HPO text, and leaves RSC-1..RSC-8 unchanged.
epr_steady_state_decisions.scope: Payment-provider enablement precedence (EPR) of the release successor, for every candidate release SHA.

decisions.text: PV3/SEC7 evidence is bound to a candidate release SHA.
A new candidate SHA may generate evidence in an isolated Preview/test-mode evidence deployment while an older SHA remains live.
Operational enablement is evaluated per candidate SHA, not globally by hosted target.
Before a candidate SHA is promoted/wired to operational payment traffic: PV3 == PASS and SEC7 == PASS for that exact SHA with current evidence.
No PASS carry-forward between SHAs by default.
No global payment outage is required to certify the next SHA.
Payment-relevant configuration changes invalidate affected evidence according to freshness/identity rules.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE remains operationally dark through PILOT_READY.
PV3/SEC7 remain mandatory for PRODUCTION_READY/full Commercial Core.

open_question_dispositions.text: GO_LIVE re-evidence of PV3 against PRODUCTION remains OPEN and FAIL-CLOSED. It is not solved by this record, and no claim is made that the GO_LIVE payment path is ready. It does not block PILOT_READY or PRODUCTION_READY when their own conditions are satisfied.
Rollback to a SHA whose required payment evidence is stale defaults to DARK ROLLBACK: payment capability remains off until that SHA has valid evidence.

A retest_after on a currently live SHA does NOT by itself force an outage. EPR remains act-bound. Fresh evidence is regenerated in an isolated evidence deployment before any later governed act that requires that evidence. No indefinite continuous-PASS semantic is created.
